Worked with a product designer to improve keyboard navigation, clarify empty states, and document interface behavior. Participated in collaborative code review and shared short progress updates with a remote team.

PROJECTS
Built a synthetic scheduling project with a browser interface and a small server-side service. Owned the interface flow, added a bounded service endpoint, and wrote a concise handover explaining broad responsibilities. The project is fictional and contains no real customer or employer information.

Completed generic computing studies and practical coursework covering web interfaces, data handling, teamwork, and responsible software delivery. Uses English regularly for project notes and distributed collaboration.

PREFERENCES
